canonical_classes.name: Healthy
canonical_classes.symptoms: Uniform green foliage without fungal lesions, necrotic spots, or powdery growth.
canonical_classes.management: Maintain standard cultural practices, balanced nutrition, and canopy aeration.

canonical_classes.name: Apple Scab
canonical_classes.symptoms: Olive-green to dark brown or black velvety spots on leaf surface, leaf deformation and early drop.
canonical_classes.management: Apply protectant fungicides (Captan, Mancozeb) at green tip; prune to improve air circulation; rake and destroy fallen leaves.

canonical_classes.name: Frog Eye Leaf Spot
canonical_classes.symptoms: Small purple spots that enlarge into circular lesions with light brown/tan centers and prominent dark purple-brown margins resembling a frog's eye.
canonical_classes.management: Prune out dead wood, twigs, and mummified fruits which harbor overwintering inoculum; apply protective fungicides in early season.

canonical_classes.name: Cedar Apple Rust
canonical_classes.symptoms: Bright yellow-orange or reddish circular spots on upper leaf surface, with small tube-like aecia forming on leaf undersides later in season.
canonical_classes.management: Eradicate nearby red cedar and juniper hosts within 1-2 miles; apply sterol inhibitor fungicides during pink bud to petal fall.

canonical_classes.name: Powdery Mildew
canonical_classes.symptoms: White to light gray powdery fungal mycelial patches on young leaves, shoots, and blossoms; leaf curling and stunted shoot growth.
canonical_classes.management: Prune infected shoots (silver tips) during dormant season; apply sulfur or myclobutanil fungicides at tight cluster stage.

canonical_classes.name: Complex Foliar Disease
canonical_classes.pathogen: Multiple concurrent fungal pathogens or secondary opportunistic infections
canonical_classes.symptoms: Overlapping necrotic lesions, multiple symptom manifestations on the same leaf surface, combined chlorosis and necrosis.
canonical_classes.management: Broad-spectrum integrated pest and disease management; laboratory leaf tissue culture if pathogen identification is ambiguous.
